tests.command: bash -c 'for d in frontend backend e2e security ops .github/workflows; do test -d "$d" || exit 1; done && git ls-files --error-unmatch e2e/.gitkeep security/.gitkeep ops/.gitkeep .github/workflows/.gitkeep >/dev/null'

bash -c 'test -f backend/app/__init__.py && for d in models schemas routers services auth audit core scripts; do test -f "backend/app/$d/__init__.py" || exit 1; done && test -f backend/tests/__init__.py && test -f backend/tests/unit/__init__.py && test -f backend/tests/integration/__init__.py && test -f backend/alembic/versions/.gitkeep'

bash -c 'for d in api components/ui components/layout components/charts components/forms components/common pages hooks context types utils test; do test -f "frontend/src/$d/.gitkeep" || exit 1; done && test -f frontend/public/.gitkeep'
bash -c 'for p in probe.db probe.sqlite3 probe.log RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK build/x coverage/x; do git check-ignore -q "$p" || exit 1; done'
bash -c 'test -d frontend && test -z "$(find e2e security ops .github -type f ! -name .gitkeep ! -name __init__.py 2>/dev/null)"'
